# Template — Lab social caption (quality only)

**Use when:** Drafting X / IG / TikTok / YT Short / Twitch promo for **Lab face**.  
**Not for:** CS2 spam as company face; “live checkout”; “we’re hiring.”

## Prompt (copy all)

```
Write social captions for DTRT Lab.

Brand rules:
- Lab = useful work. DTRTC = entertainment stream (mention only when dual-brand is the point).
- Quality only. No fake scale, live store, or hiring theater.
- X strips https links — use plain dtrtlab.com when needed.
- TikTok AI VO must keep video_made_with_ai labeling when ElevenLabs/AI VO is used.
- Tone: talk to one person. Warm, plain, energy 5–6. Spell DTRT as letters if spoken.

Script / topic: {{TOPIC}}
Platforms needed: {{PLATFORMS}}
CTA: {{CTA_OR_dtrtlab.com}}
Dual-brand mention?: {{YES_NO}}

Return HTML-ish short blocks per platform:
- X (≤280 chars worth of text, plain dtrtlab.com)
- Instagram (short paragraphs)
- TikTok (1–2 lines)
- YouTube Short title + 1-line description (unlisted-friendly)
- Twitch only if dual-brand = YES (no Lab chrome takeover)

Also give one on-screen text line (≤6 words).
```
